nav.money_hint: Money in and out, and what waits for a shareholder
nav.setup_money_hint: Accounts, expense categories, dues and shareholders
nav.approvals_hint: When a manager's entry waits for a shareholder
money.help.expense: Money spent on running the shop: rent, milk, repairs. Not for paying a vendor or publisher.
money.help.income: Money in that isn't a sale: an event fee, a refund, a sponsorship.
money.help.due_taken: Someone took goods and will pay later. No money moves today; their due goes up.
money.help.due_collected: Someone paid what they owed. Money comes into an account and their due goes down.
money.help.loan_to_shareholder: The shop lends money to a shareholder. They owe it back.
money.help.loan_from_shareholder: A shareholder lends money to the shop. The shop owes it back.
money.help.loan_repayment: A loan between the shop and a shareholder is paid back, in either direction.
money.help.transfer: Money moves between two of the shop's own accounts, for example from the cash drawer to bKash. It isn't spent or earned.
money.help.owner_salary: A shareholder's monthly salary, paid from the shop.
money.help.profit_share: A shareholder's share of the profit, paid out.
money.help.owner_withdrawal: A shareholder takes money out of the shop for themselves.
money.ref_help: A bill, receipt or bKash transaction number, if there is one.
money.direction.in: The shareholder pays the shop back
money.direction.out: The shop pays the shareholder back
money.no_categories: No categories yet. A shareholder adds them in Setup: money.
money.will_be_final: This will be final when saved.
money.will_wait: This will wait for a shareholder:
approve.why.request: It's a request: entering this kind needs a shareholder.
approve.why.category: Its category always needs a shareholder.
approve.why.kind_rule: Entries of this kind are confirmed by a shareholder.
approve.why.duplicate: It was saved past a duplicate warning.
money.correcting: You're correcting entry {id}. The old entry is kept and marked corrected.
money.pair_note: Saving this transfer cancels entry {id}, the other half.
money.saved_waiting: Saved. It waits for a shareholder.
money.saved_on_phone: No connection. Saved on this phone; it will be sent when you're online.
money.cancel_help: The entry is kept, marked cancelled, and stops counting.
dup.title: This may already be entered
dup.twin: An entry of the same kind and amount for the same person or category was made within {days} days.
dup.transfer_pair: There's an opposite entry of the same amount on the same day in another account. Together they may be one transfer.
dup.transfer_words: The note mentions bKash, a bank, cash out or a deposit. If money only moved between the shop's own accounts, it's a transfer.
dup.reason_help: It will wait for a shareholder, with this reason.
home.mine_waiting: {count, plural, one {# of your entries waits} other {# of your entries wait}} for a shareholder.
setup.accounts_help: Where the shop's money is: the cash drawer, bKash, bank accounts. There is exactly one cash drawer.
setup.categories_help: What money is spent on. Tick a category when its expenses always need a shareholder.
setup.contacts_help: Customers and others who take goods now and pay later.
setup.shareholders_help: The owners, for loans, salaries and profit shares.
setup.account_kind_help: The cash drawer is the one counted at the end of each day.
setup.opening_help: What the account held when you started using the app.
setup.area_help: Which part of the business the cost belongs to, for profit by area.
setup.needs_shareholder_help: A manager's expense in this category always waits for a shareholder, whatever the amount.
setup.opening_due_help: What they already owed when you started using the app.
setup.similar_body: "{name}" is close to "{existing}". Use "{existing}", or save "{name}" as a different category?
approvals.intro: A shareholder's own entries are always final. These rules decide when a manager's entry waits for a shareholder.
approvals.limit_help: A manager's entry above this amount waits for a shareholder.
val.amount_positive: The amount must be more than zero.
val.not_found: This no longer exists or is inactive. Choose another.
val.same_account: Choose a different account to move the money to.
val.one_drawer: There is already a cash drawer: {name}.
val.need_drawer: The shop needs one active cash drawer.
err.own_entry: Someone else has to approve your own entry.
nav.month_closing_hint: The month's profit, shares, and closing it
nav.shareholders_hint: Shares, loans with interest, and each shareholder's account
month.interest_from: Interest on loans taken by shareholders
month.book_cost: Cost of books sold and written off
month.interest_owed: Interest owed to shareholders who lent
month.loss_before: Loss from earlier months, made up first
month.no_shares: No shares are set: see Shareholders.
month.step.days: Every day of the month closed ({count} still open)
sh.from_help: The shares apply from this date; earlier months keep theirs.
sh.rate_help: Worked out day by day on what is owed. Empty: no interest.
sh.accounts_help: From closed months: owner salary, profit share and interest owed to each, less what was paid or withdrawn, against advances and loans taken with their interest.
sh.loans_help: Each loan has its own yearly rate. Loan entries on the Money screen name their loan.
sh.salary_help: Counted in each month's figures and owed to the shareholder.
money.loan_help: Name the loan so its interest is worked out.
setup.holder_help: For money held by a shareholder: who holds it. What it holds is owed by them to the business.
val.holder_owner_only: Only money held by a shareholder names who holds it.
